decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The window(s) in the first floor flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding the approved details and prior to the
commencement of development, full details of the permeable paving and details
relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Details thereby approved shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The AMS (10.1 – 10.2, DAB_24RPR_AIA_001, Chris Wallis TreeSense March 2025) submitted in support shall be adhered to in full, including all pre-arranged tree protection monitoring and site supervision (detailed in 10.2 and Appendix A, inspection Form) by the appointed specialist. Copies of the completed inspection form shall be emailed to the LPA within 28 days of completion of the development. This condition may only be discharged on completion of the development subject to written evidence of compliance with the approved tree protection throughout construction.</p>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted, pruned or destroyed during the development phase and thereafter within 5 years of completion of the development, without written approval by the LPA.</p>
<p>The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the existing dwellinghouse and shall not be used as separate residential accommodation at anytime.</p>
description: Front porch, Installation of bay window in first floor front elevation,  Single and two storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormers, Roof lights in front roof slope, Brick pillars and iron gates to front,External alterations, Detached single storey outbuilding to rear for use as Study/Gym (Demolition of gate canopy to front, rear extension, detached garage and greenhouse to rear)
